name: Plan
gate: every feature sequenced into a phase

require.label: sequence every feature into a phase
resolve TODO/FIXME markers in the written sections

blurb: Sequence the feature DAG into phases — in the plan DB; issues are generated at publish, not here.
prompt:
The features are a dependency DAG — run `bsc-plan feature list` to see every feature and its
`dependsOn`. SEQUENCE them into a roadmap by assigning each feature a **phase IN THE PLAN DB** — do
NOT write phases.json or any issue files. Phases live in plan.db; issues are generated from the
features at GitHub-publish time, not during planning (no `bsc-plan add`).

Group the features into ordered phases (foundations first — a feature's `dependsOn` features land in
the same or an earlier phase) and assign EVERY feature its phase by re-running `bsc-plan feature add`
with the slug + phase:
  `echo '{"slug":"sketcher","phase":2}' | bsc-plan feature add`  (merges in place — slug + phase only).
Use a consistent phase number (or short phase name). When every feature is phased, present the phase
order + the dependency graph and get the user's APPROVAL. Leave no TODO / TBD / FIXME / XXX markers —
the gate blocks on them.

Where a real cross-feature contract exists (a shared schema/types/API), write it as a doc under
`contracts/<name>.md` — the director owns those and workers read them as the source of truth.

substeps.label: Sequence features into phases
substeps.gate: every feature is phased in the DB
substeps.prompt:
Using the feature DAG (`bsc-plan feature list`), sequence the features into ordered
phases — foundations first, a feature's `dependsOn` features in the same or an earlier phase. Assign
EVERY feature its phase in the plan DB via `echo '{"slug":"…","phase":<n or name>}' | bsc-plan feature add`
(merges in place — slug + phase only). Do NOT write phases.json or any issues — phases live in the DB,
and issues are generated from the features afterward, not in this stage. Present the phase order + the
dependency graph and get the user's APPROVAL.
